sentences.en: I think a movie is more entertaining than any book.
sentences.zh: 我觉得看电影比看书更有趣。

sentences.en: The picture I saw then was a most entertaining one.
sentences.zh: 我看到的那一张照片非常有趣。

sentences.en: The purpose of this challenge is to entertain the public.
sentences.zh: 这次挑战的目的就是取悦公众。

senses.zh: 使欢乐, 使娱乐 - 抱有, 考虑

mnemonic: 词根记忆：enter（进入）+tain（拿住）→在（工作）中间抓住时间（休息）→使娱乐
